title: Aerodynamics
description: Air pressed faster over the top of a wing pushes less on it than the slower air below: Bernoulli's trade of speed for pressure, written as the lift equation. Tilt the wing too far and the flow tears off it, and it stalls. Unlocks the Wind Tunnel and the Aerofoil Composite.

puzzle.goal: A wing of area A with lift coefficient C flies through air of density ρ at speed v. Lift is the dynamic pressure, ½ρv², times the area, times how good the wing is at turning it into lift. Write F, the lift.
puzzle.name: The lift equation
puzzle.ask: Find F in N for a light aircraft: ρ = @{ρ} kg/m³, v = @{v} m/s, A = @{A} m², C = @{C}.
puzzle.method: Bernoulli: p + ½ρv² is constant along a streamline, so the pressure difference across the wing scales with ½ρv².
